verdict.rationale: Workers' Wrangler CLI and bindings system (docs-9,10,11) let devs declare resources, routes, and triggers in a config file and deploy via CLI, and community feedback confirms fast, simple deploys (comm-3, comm-11). However, no evidence pack item explicitly describes a single unified config file capturing the 'entire architecture' or built-in versioning/rollback workflow, so full IaC-style version control is not demonstrated.
